quickTry.title: Quick test
quickTry.hint: See which rule a cost price hits

list.matchOrder: Match order: supplier + store › supplier › store › global; within each, the higher priority number wins
list.emptyDescription: Try different filters, or create a new rule.
list.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}}. Use filters to narrow it down.

editor.name: Name
editor.intervalHint: Tap an interval to change its limits and pricing. A cost equal to a boundary uses the lower interval.
editor.chartCaption: Cost {{from}} to {{to}} · gold fixed, blue curve, orange is the rounded retail price
editor.deleteBody: This can't be undone. Products using this rule will be priced by other rules.
editor.presetFixedBody: Use one fixed markup of 2.5× for every cost.
editor.presetCurveBody: Go back to the default curve.
editor.legacyBody: Step, linear and exponential rules can't be edited on mobile. After converting, each interval can be fixed or a curve. Nothing changes live until you save.
editor.convertedHint: Please check these changes before saving:
editor.convertedNoChanges: The conversion doesn't change any prices.
editor.dropsTitle: Prices drop at some boundaries. Save anyway?
editor.dropsHint: At these boundaries a higher cost gives a lower price (tiered pricing). Please confirm this is intended:

interval.title: Interval {{n}} · {{range}}
interval.fixedFormula: Retail = cost × {{rate}}, rounded up to .50 or .99 (whole numbers become .99, except 1 and 2). In this interval: {{from}} → {{to}}
interval.bendDisabled: A straight line has no bend

rules.rateOk: Every interval's markup is between 1.5 and 5
rules.coverage: Intervals join up and cover cost {{from}} to {{to}}
rules.monotonic: Within each interval, price never drops and markup never rises
rules.drops: {{count}} price drops at boundaries (tiered pricing), confirm on save
rules.continuous: Prices are continuous at every boundary
rules.beyond: Costs above {{max}} won't use this rule

notes.raisedMin: Interval {{n}}: lower limit {{from}} raised to 0.10 (costs below 0.10 can't be priced anyway)
notes.stepToFixedEndIgnored: Interval {{n}}: step → fixed markup {{rate}}× (the old end markup {{end}} was never used for pricing)
notes.expToCurve: Interval {{n}}: exponential → curve. End prices stay the same, but prices in between will differ. Please check the chart.
notes.drops: {{count}} price drops at boundaries (tiered pricing), confirm on save

errors.noIntervals: Add at least one price interval
errors.notNumber: Interval {{n}}: limits and markups must be numbers
errors.rangeInvalid: Interval {{n}}: cost starts at 0.10 and the upper limit must be above the lower limit
errors.notContiguous: Interval {{n}}: intervals must join up with no gaps
errors.rateRange: Interval {{n}}: markup must be between 1.5 and 5
errors.fixedRatesDiffer: Interval {{n}}: a fixed markup must have the same start and end
errors.fixedHasCurve: Interval {{n}}: a fixed markup can't have node prices or a bend
errors.unsupported: Interval {{n}}: only fixed markups or curves with node prices are supported
errors.endpointRateRange: Interval {{n}}: end-point prices must be 1.5 to 5 times the cost
errors.monotonic: Interval {{n}}: as cost goes up, price can't drop and markup can't rise
errors.startTail: Interval {{n}}: the start price must end in .50 or .99
errors.endTail: Interval {{n}}: the end price must end in .50 or .99
errors.bendInvalid: Interval {{n}}: invalid bend direction or amount
errors.bendTooLarge: Interval {{n}}: the bend is too large and would make price drop or markup rise. Reduce the bend.
errors.noTailAtBoundary: No .50/.99 price between 1.5× and 5× at this boundary
errors.boundaryOutOfRange: The upper limit must be above {{min}} and below {{max}}
errors.minTooHigh: The lower limit must be below this interval's upper limit
errors.maxTooLow: The upper limit must be above this interval's lower limit
errors.noTailAtCost: No .50/.99 price between 1.5× and 5× at this cost
errors.notFixed: Only fixed intervals have a single markup
errors.unboundedCurve: An interval with no upper limit can't be a curve. Set an upper limit first.
errors.noTailInInterval: No .50/.99 price between 1.5× and 5× in this interval
errors.fixedNoEndpoint: Fixed intervals don't have end-point prices
errors.endpointLocked: This end point follows the neighbouring fixed interval. Unlink it first.
errors.noTailForNeighbors: No .50/.99 price here fits the neighbouring intervals
errors.fixedUseRate: Set the markup directly for a fixed interval
errors.fixedNoShape: Fixed intervals don't have a curve shape
errors.tooNarrow: This interval is too narrow to split
errors.noTailAtMid: No .50/.99 price between 1.5× and 5× at the midpoint
errors.unboundedAppend: The last interval has no upper limit, so there's nothing to add after it. Use Split, or give it an upper limit first.
errors.nearMax: The upper limit is close to the system maximum, so no more intervals can be added
errors.noTailForNew: No .50/.99 price between 1.5× and 5× for the new interval
errors.keepOne: Keep at least one price interval
errors.convertEmpty: There are no intervals to convert
errors.convertBounds: Interval {{n}}: invalid limits. Fix them on the web first.
errors.convertNoTail: Interval {{n}}: no .50/.99 end-point price between 1.5× and 5×, so it can't be converted
errors.priorityInvalid: Priority must be 0 or a whole number
errors.storeRequired: A store-level rule needs at least one store
errors.supplierRequired: A supplier-level rule needs at least one supplier
errors.legacyNotConverted: Convert the legacy intervals before saving
errors.forbidden: This account isn't allowed to do that
errors.notFound: This rule doesn't exist or has been deleted
